# UWP-only addition (not in the MSVC desktop .targets): console-win32.c's
# ConsoleDriver icalls are all HAVE_CLASSIC_WINAPI_SUPPORT-gated, so under
# UWP the null console driver provides them (Isatty/SetEcho/SetBreak/
# InternalKeyAvailable/TtySetup). Harmless on desktop builds of this list:
# the two files define the same symbols, so never compile both there.
